title: Domain Registrations: Hosting Plan Allowance within Domain Care, Grace-Period Renewal Charges
content:
## Plan allowance — grace-period renewal charges

The grace line's plan allowance is one of the Domain Care credits that a grace-period renewal charge of Domain Registrations earns, where the charge was billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal. It turns on the active Harborline hosting plan under Web Hosting Plans whose primary domain is this domain:

- **Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4 or Harborline Cloud 8:** the amount by which the TLD's renewal price exceeds its registration price, for each year the charge covered, that amount being never less than USD 0.75 for each year the charge covered, also where the renewal price does not exceed the registration price.
- **Harborline Starter, Harborline Plus or Harborline Pro:** the flat USD 0.75, once for the charge, whatever the TLD's prices and whatever the years.
- **No such plan active:** nothing.

The prices are those of the domain's TLD product in the Domain Registrations price schedule.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical prices, not those of any TLD)

| Plan | TLD prices (hypothetical) | Years on the charge | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Cloud 4 | renew USD 40.00, register USD 30.00 | 1 | USD 10.00 |
| Harborline Cloud 4 | renew USD 40.00, register USD 30.00 | 3 | USD 30.00 |
| Harborline Business | renew USD 30.50, register USD 30.00 | 2 | USD 0.75 for each year, USD 1.50 |
| Harborline Pro | any | 3 | USD 0.75 |
| none active | any | any | nothing |

In the third row the excess of USD 0.50 falls under the floor of USD 0.75 for each year, so the floor governs.
